definitions.gloss: matching set; complete set; uniform appearance
definitions.explanation: A group of items or people that are matched or coordinated in appearance. Also used to describe the quality or caliber of a group.

examples.japanese: {揃|そろ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{粒|つぶ}{揃|ぞろ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧だ。
examples.english: The team is full of top-quality players.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{揃|そろ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧Tシャツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: The whole family put on matching T-shirts and took a photo.

notes:
USAGE:
{揃|そろ}い is the noun form of the verb ⟦{揃|そろ}う→揃う：01953_sorou⟧ (to be aligned, to match). It is frequently used as a modifier: {揃|そろ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ (matching clothes), {揃|そろ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧ (matching tableware).

COMPOUNDS:
- {粒|つぶ}{揃|ぞろ}い — uniformly high quality (of people or items); every member is excellent
- お{揃|そろ}い — matching (casual/friendly tone, often for couples or groups wearing the same thing)
